name: Roses Are Green
source:
Sage is just your average deadbeat twentysomething, but he's about to have a spring that he'll never forget.

When his Uncle enlists him for some volunteer work at the family flower shop, the last thing he expects is to meet the mysterious and beautiful Rosie. The intoxicating fragrance of flowers hangs thick in the air over this short, dark romantic horror story. Will their relationship blossom into something precious, or will the rose's thorns entangle Sage in a web that will spell his ruin?

[From [url=https://heartpunchstudio.itch.io/roses-are-green]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
赛奇不过是个游手好闲的二十来岁普通青年，但今年春天，他即将迎来一段永生难忘的经历。

当叔叔叫他去自家花店搭把手做义工时，他做梦也没想到自己会邂逅神秘而美丽的萝茜。在这部短篇暗黑浪漫恐怖故事中，令人迷醉的浓郁花香弥漫在空气里。两人的关系究竟会绽放成珍贵的恋情，还是说玫瑰的尖刺会将赛奇死死缠入万劫不复的罗网？

[摘自[url=https://heartpunchstudio.itch.io/roses-are-green]itch.io[/url]]
